missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics: active/idle connections, max_connections, wait events
Order service pool configuration and pool wait/acquire metrics
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size 5/idle 0 is observed only in traces; no direct Postgres saturation metrics confirm exhaustion versus slow queries.

report.explanation: Traces show all checkout failures originate at postgres.save_order (pool size 5, idle 0, DependencyUnavailable ~2s), propagating as order 503s and gateway ReadTimeout/502s; inventory and payment succeed. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; direct Postgres saturation metrics are still needed to confirm.
